name: Baseline FSAE-style rear corner (rear-left)
description: Starter rear double-wishbone geometry with plausible FSAE dimensions: a fixed toe link behind the axle instead of a steering tie rod, pushrod and rocker, driven axle. A starting point for the Phase 7 optimiser, not a validated design.
coordinate_system: SAE/ISO vehicle axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Origin on the ground plane, on the car centerline, at the REAR axle line.

packaging._note: 10 inch rim envelope, checked in the wheel's own frame (see solver/suspkin/packaging.py)

vehicle._note: Whole-car numbers (see solver/suspkin/sideview.py). Same made-up car as the front file; this corner is on the driven rear axle. spring_rate_n_per_mm is one rear corner's spring.

rocker._note: Pushrod and rocker (bellcrank). The rocker spins about 'axis' through RKP. See solver/suspkin/rocker.py.

point_descriptions.RTI: Toe link inner end (fixed on the chassis)
point_descriptions.RTO: Toe link outer end (on the upright, behind the axle)
point_descriptions.PRO: Pushrod outer end (bracket on the lower A-arm)
point_descriptions.RKP: Rocker pivot (on its rotation axis, on the chassis)
